title: Loads.
officialText:
At no time shall a scaffold be loaded beyond the capacity of the scaffold or the ground or structure upon
which it rests or is supported. Loads shall not be concentrated so as to cause stresses in excess of the allowable values
designated for the applicable material described in this code.
